$comment: SYNTHETIC. A bound written as a glob — 'everything under this owner' — by
an operator who has just written `Read(//mnt/secrets-store/**)` in the deny list
A scope value is an exact string comparison, so a glob would match nothing
and the agent would have a server that refuses every call. It does not get
that far: the schema refuses the spelling when the config is read. That is
the whole point of this fixture — the inert-rule defect the rest of this
table keeps finding in the tool policy is structurally closed on the bound,
and closed at load rather than at 3am at call time.
